transcript: It is easy to lose consciousness when you are distracted. When you are distracted, you kick into autopilot mode, and autopilot does exactly what it was programmed to do, right? And so sometimes that looks like your past coming up and showing up in the present moment because you're distracted with other things. And so you are out of the loop and not realizing that the past has taken over. The more that I assess my life and I assess this journey, I'm realizing that I have to break this journey into small bite-sized pieces. I have to live day by day, checking in the seconds, the minutes, the hours. That is what matters. We can plan for everything and anything, but we will not leave this earth unscathed and it will never look the way that we thought it would look.
